summary: Bound replication transport buffers and checkpoint assembly; share retry answers without copying payloads

replay.detail: No full replay or derived-data rebuild is introduced.

schema.detail: No database, index or persisted format changes.

rules.detail: Complete checkpoint certificates, dropped payload exclusion, admission, idempotency and frontier authority remain unchanged. A failed or incomplete fetch is never adopted.

compatibility.detail: Wire fields, signing bytes and receipt acknowledgements are unchanged. Worker signed encoders and response readers enforce the existing 64 MiB exchange cap before allocating a whole body. Checkpoint assembly enforces the existing 1 GiB daemon adoption cap before accumulating more rows, rejects non-advancing cursors, and still requires certificate verification after complete fetch. Retry waiters share one immutable answer; receive IPC serializes a borrowed exchange and decodes the value from borrowed JSON instead of building an intermediate generic tree.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no migration or startup phase is added. Worker RSS, local API fairness and throughput require the existing post-deploy measurement route.

manual.detail: No resource-limit increase, live repair or configuration change is needed.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back uses the unchanged store. Refused oversized bodies or invalid manifest pages commit no partial adoption.
